acceptance_criteria: `swx-qa thumbnail <document>` (with `--features occt`) reads an unpacked folder or a `.sltwx` part. It loads every body that has a fresh `cache/body-<id>.brep` through `load_body`, renders them with the same fixed isometric view and shading as `swx-qa render` at 256 × 256 px, and stores the PNG as the `thumbnail.png` cache entry with the document's current `model_hash`. Then it writes the document back in the form it was read from.

Test: a 40 × 25 × 10 mm box as body `b-1`, cached with `build_part_cache`. After `swx-qa thumbnail`, reading the document back gives a fresh `thumbnail.png` (`fresh_cache_file("thumbnail.png")` is `Some`), and it decodes as a 256 × 256 PNG with at least 10 % of its pixels differing from the background colour. Checked for both the unpacked and the `.sltwx` form.
Test: running the command twice on the same document gives byte-identical `thumbnail.png` bytes and byte-identical container output.

Test: a document with no fresh body BRep (no cache, or the cache made stale by changing one parameter expression in `model`) makes the command exit with status 1. Its stderr says the cache must be built first, and the document's files are unchanged byte for byte.
Without `--features occt`, `swx-qa thumbnail` exits with status 1 and a message that it needs the `occt` feature (same pattern as `render --step`).
One appended ADR line in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` records the `swx-qa → swx-io` path dependency and the `occt` forwarding. No new third-party dependency.
All existing tests pass unchanged; no test is weakened or removed.

`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass, and `cargo clippy -p swx-qa --features occt --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -p swx-qa --features occt` pass.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
objective.description: M4-04f: swx-qa thumbnail: render a part's thumbnail.png from its cached body BReps
